pages.text: The variometer is built into hang glider flight. While gliding with the Hang Glider engaged or while elytra-flying with a Thermal Elytra, press $(thing)V$() to toggle audio feedback for vertical speed.

Rising air beeps faster and at a higher pitch; sinking air slows and lowers the tone. Bind $(thing)Variometer Volume Up$() and $(thing)Variometer Volume Down$() in controls to adjust loudness. Thermals in the Overworld daytime help you climb; rain can pull you down.
Craft the glider first, then use $(thing)V$() in flight.
